title: Colossal sculpture of Ramesses II, Memphis
creator: Daniel Pett (Dejp3)
modifications: Removed tall crown and rear slab. Sequential plane clipping with concave Earcut caps, conforming edge refinement and irregular relief on the forehead, neck and rear break surfaces; welded boundaries and repaired outward winding. Runtime deformation lowers mouth corners and inner brows, compresses the lower lip, adds lip wrinkles, a glabellar furrow, nasolabial creases and an asymmetric sneer. Dark object-local branching cracks cross broken outer surfaces. Runtime scaling, burial and cool mineral stone are literary interpretation, not historical reconstruction. The scan remains closed.
